items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But he worked, both he and his son, he had a son named Billy Jr. that played.

ctx.x: He went to Washington and worked in the Post Office for quite some time.
But he worked, both he and his son, he had a son named Billy Jr. that played. And they both, I don‟t know it was kind of tragic because I thought they both were excellent players.
